services.name: AmendmentService
services.documentation: Information on Amendments to legislation considered by the Washington State Legislature.

operations.name: GetAmendments
operations.documentation:
Returns list of amendments submitted to the rostrum during the year. 
Exception thrown for invalid year.

fields.name: BillNumber
fields.documentation: 3 or 4 digit number assigned to a piece of legislation.

fields.name: Name
fields.documentation: Title of amendment, document, or entity name. Paired with the LegislativeSession, this is a unique reference to the amendment. It is also the name of the document on the legislature's web site.

fields.name: BillId
fields.documentation: Prefix and bill number of a piece of legislation. When paired with the biennium, it is a unique reference to legislation. This field is commonly used for display purposes on legislative reports.

fields.name: LegislativeSession
fields.documentation: Session description. In the case of the amendment, it is the only session the amendment can be considered on the floor.

fields.name: Type
fields.documentation: Describes what body originally considered the amendment (Amendment Class), or sub-classification of the document (LegislativeDocument Class), or type of bill sponsor (Sponsor Class).

fields.name: FloorNumber
fields.documentation: Number assigned to a floor amendment when it is submitted to the floor for consideration. This number is unique for the legislative session.

fields.name: SponsorName
fields.documentation: Primary sponsor of the amendment.

fields.name: Description
fields.documentation: Describes the content of the amendment or document. For amendments, if the amendment is a page and line amendment, it will list the first page and line reference. If it is a striking amendment, 'striker' will be in the description field.

fields.name: Drafter
fields.documentation: Abbreviated designation of the amendment drafter and draft version. If the drafter begins with H-, S-, or Z-, the document has been drafted by staff in the Code Reviser's Office. Otherwise the first characters of the drafter are an abbreviation of the staff member's last name along with the version of this draft.

fields.name: FloorAction
fields.documentation: Action taken by the legislative body during a floor session.

fields.name: FloorActionDate
fields.documentation: Date of action taken by the legislative body during a floor session.

fields.name: DocumentExists
fields.documentation: True if the legislative document related to the object's meta data is available electronically on the legislature's web site.

fields.name: HtmUrl
fields.documentation: URL path to HTML version of the legislative document.

fields.name: PdfUrl
fields.documentation: URL path to PDF version of the legislative document.

fields.name: Agency
fields.documentation: Legislative Body.

fields.name: Biennium
fields.documentation: Two year time period beginning on odd years. Legislation introduced during this time period can be considered in any sessions scheduled within the time period. Information is only available from 1991-current.

fields.name: BillId
fields.documentation: Prefix and bill number of a piece of legislation. When paired with the biennium, it is a unique reference to legislation. This field is commonly used for display purposes on legislative reports.

fields.name: BillNumber
fields.documentation: 3 or 4 digit number assigned to a piece of legislation.

fields.name: SubstituteVersion
fields.documentation: Substitute version of the legislation. Standing committees in the originating body can recommend substitutes to a piece of legislation. When the bill is considered on the floor, the legislative body will decide what version (original or a specific substitute version) they will vote on. There is no limit on the substitute version although it is rare to go above 4.

fields.name: EngrossedVersion
fields.documentation: The engrossed version of the bill number. Each time the bill is amended on the floor by the body it originated in, its engrossed version is incremented by one.

fields.name: ShortLegislationType
fields.documentation: Abbreviated designation of the type of legislation.

fields.name: OriginalAgency
fields.documentation: Legislative body that the legislation was originally introduced.

fields.name: ShortLegislationType
fields.documentation: Abbreviated designation of the type of legislation.

fields.name: LongLegislationType
fields.documentation: Descriptive designation of the type of legislation.

fields.name: ReferredDate

fields.documentation: Title of amendment, document, or entity name. Paired with the LegislativeSession, this is a unique reference to the amendment. It is also the name of the document on the legislature's web site.

fields.name: LongName

fields.name: Agency
fields.documentation: Legislative Body.

fields.name: AgendaId

fields.name: HearingDate

services.name: LegislationService
services.documentation: Information on legislation being considered by the Washington State Legislature.

operations.name: GetAmendmentsForYear
operations.documentation:
Returns a list of all pending and acted on amendments for the bill during the year. 
Exception thrown for invalid year.

operations.name: GetAmendmentsForBiennium
operations.documentation:
Returns a list of all pending and acted on amendments for the bill during the biennium. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetHearings
operations.documentation:
Returns a list of committee hearings for the bill. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationByRequestNumber
operations.documentation:
Returns legislation information based on the original request number of the draft submitted. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or requestNumber or if no information found. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetRcwCitesAffected
operations.documentation:
Returns RCW Cites referenced within the legislation. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or billId. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetSessionLawChapter
operations.documentation:
Returns chapter and session law information on given bill. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or billId. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetSponsors
operations.documentation:
Returns list of bill sponsors. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or billId. 
Expects biennium in the format 2005-06.

operations.name: GetRollCalls
operations.documentation:
Returns list of roll calls taken on the bill. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium. 
Expects biennium in the format 2005-06.

operations.name: GetCurrentStatus
operations.documentation:
Returns the current status of the bill in the legislative process. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or if no status found. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationTypes
operations.documentation: Returns a list of all valid types of legislation.

operations.name: GetTotalLegislationIntroducedByDateRange
operations.documentation: Returns legislation introduced in the given date range by the given legislation type.

operations.name: GetLegislation
operations.documentation:
Returns legislation information on the bill.  If substitutes to the bill have been proposed, they will be listed separately.  The active flag is true for versions that can be passed on the floor. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationIntroducedSince
operations.documentation: Returns detailed legislation information on all bills introduced since the date given.  If substitutes to the bill have been proposed, they will be listed separately.  The active flag is true for versions that can be passed on the floor.

operations.name: GetPrefiledLegislation
operations.documentation:
Returns detailed legislation information on all prefiled bills (currently in prefiled status). 
Once a bill is formally introduced, its information can be obtained by calling the GetLegislation method.

operations.name: GetLegislationHistoricalRecapCategoriesByLegislationNumber
operations.documentation:
Returns the legislation historical recap (status) categories for the given bill number. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or date range. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationByYear
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills active during the year.  If substitutes to the bill have been proposed, they will be listed separately.  The active flag is true for versions that can be passed on the floor. 
Exception thrown for invalid year. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationInfoIntroducedSince
operations.documentation: Returns summary legislation information on all bills introduced since the date given.  If substitutes to the bill have been proposed, they will be listed separately.  The active flag is true for versions that can be passed on the floor.

operations.name: GetPreFiledLegislationInfo
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all prefiled bills (currently in prefiled status). 
Once a bill is formally introduced, its information can be obtained by calling the GetLegislation method.

operations.name: GetHouseLegislationPassedHouse
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all House bills that have passed the House.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetHouseLegislationPassedSenate
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all House bills that have passed the Senate.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetSenateLegislationPassedSenate
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all Senate bills that have passed the Senate.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetSenateLegislationPassedHouse
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all Senate bills that have passed the House.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedLegislature
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have passed the legislature.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedLegislatureWithinTimeFrame
operations.documentation: Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have passed the legislature within the begin and end date.

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedHouse
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have passed the House.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedSenate
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have passed the Senate.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationGovernorSigned
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have been signed by the governor.
Exception thrown for invalid agency or biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06
Agency should be House or Senate.

operations.name: GetLegislationGovernorVeto
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have been vetoed by the governor.
Exception thrown for invalid agency or biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06
Agency should be House or Senate.

operations.name: GetLegislationGovernorPartialVeto
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have been partially vetoed by the governor.
Exception thrown for invalid agency or biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06
Agency should be House or Senate.

operations.name: GetPublishedEnrolledLegislation
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on all bills that have been enrolled and published by the legislature.
Exception thrown for invalid biennium.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedHouseWithinTimeFrame
operations.documentation: Returns summary legislation information on all bills that House passed off the floor for the first time between the begin and end date (even if the bill is not currently passed the House - For example, a House bill that the House passed may have been amended in the Senate and the House has not passed the amended version of the bill.  This bill would still be returned in this method.  If you don't want that bill, use the GetLegislationPassedHouse.).

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedSenateWithinTimeFrame
operations.documentation: Returns summary legislation information on all bills that Senate passed off the floor for the first time between the begin and end date (even if the bill is not currently passed the House - For example, a Senate bill that the Senate passed may have been amended in the House and the Senate has not passed the amended version of the bill.  This bill would still be returned in this method.  If you don't want that bill, use the GetLegislationPassedSenate.).

operations.name: GetLegislationNotYetIntroducedInHouseOfOrigin
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on bills that are active, have available bill text, and have not yet been introduced in the house of origin.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.name: GetLegislationPassedOriginalBodyAndNotIntroducedInOppositeBody
operations.documentation:
Returns summary legislation information on bills that have passed the originating body and not yet introduced in opposite body.
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06

operations.documentation: Returns a .net DataTable for the LegislativeBillList SharePoint Feature

services.name: LegislativeDocumentService
services.documentation: Information on documents relating to legislation of the Washington State Legislature.

operations.name: GetDocumentsByClass
operations.documentation:
Lists legislative documents of the given document class with names starting with the namedlike value. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium, documentClass or namedLike or when no documents found. 
Expects the biennium in the format: 2005-06.  Information is available back to 1991-92. For Initiatives to the Legislature, enter the following in namedLike: Initiative. 
The results will include URLs to PDF and HTM versions of each document.

operations.name: GetDocuments
operations.documentation:
Lists legislative documents with names starting with the namedlike value. Exception thrown for invalid biennium or namedLike or when no documents found. Expects the biennium in the format: 2005-06. Information is available back to 1991-92.For Initiatives to the Legislature, enter the following in namedLike: Initiative.
The results will include URLs to PDF and HTM versions of each document.

operations.name: GetDocumentClasses
operations.documentation:
Returns available bill family document types for the given biennium. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06.  Information is available back to 1991-92.

operations.name: GetAllDocumentsByClass
operations.documentation:
Lists all legislative documents of the given document class. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or documentClass. 
Expects the biennium in the format: 2005-06.  Information is available back to 1991-92. 
The results will include URLs to PDF and HTM versions of each document.

services.documentation: Information on legislation relating to session laws of the Washington State Legislature.

operations.name: GetSessionLawByBill
operations.documentation:
Returns session law information for a bill. Note: This will not return information on Initiatives to the Legislature. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or when no session law found. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06.

operations.name: GetBillByChapterNumber
operations.documentation:
Returns Bill information for a chapter. 
Exception thrown for invalid year or when no legislation found. 
Expects year in the format: YYYY. Session is the SessionCode (0=Regular Session, 1=1st Special Session, etc.).

operations.name: GetChapterNumbersByYear
operations.documentation:
Returns all Chapters for a year. 
Exception thrown for invalid year. 
Expects year in the format: YYYY.

operations.name: GetSessionLawByBillId
operations.documentation:
Returns session law information for a billId. 
Exception thrown for invalid biennium or when no session law found. 
Expects biennium to be in the format: 2005-06.

operations.name: GetSessionLawByInitiativeNumber
operations.documentation:
Returns session law information for an Initiative to the Legislature. 
Exception thrown when no session law found.

fields.name: IntroducedDate
fields.documentation: Date that the bill was read first time on the floor of the originating body.

fields.name: Sponsor
fields.documentation: Common display string of sponsor name. If the bill is a committee, the string will contain the committee acronym followed by the primary sponsor of the original bill in parens.

fields.name: PrimeSponsorID
fields.documentation: Unique identifier for the primary sponsor of the legislation.

fields.name: LongDescription
fields.documentation: Summary of legislation written by staff in the Code Reviser's Office. Can also be referred to as the Brief Description.

fields.name: LegalTitle
fields.documentation: Summary of legislation or jingle.
examples: An act relating to salmon recovery

fields.name: BillId
fields.documentation: Prefix and bill number of a piece of legislation. When paired with the biennium, it is a unique reference to legislation. This field is commonly used for display purposes on legislative reports.

fields.name: HistoryLine
fields.documentation: One line describing the action taken on the legislation.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.documentation: Date that action was taken on the legislation.

fields.name: AmendedByOppositeBody
fields.documentation: True if the chamber that did not introduce the bill passed amendments to the bill.

fields.name: PartialVeto
fields.documentation: True if the governor has partially vetoed the bill.

fields.name: Veto
fields.documentation: True if the governor has vetoed the legislation.

fields.name: BillId
fields.documentation: Prefix and bill number of a piece of legislation. When paired with the biennium, it is a unique reference to legislation. This field is commonly used for display purposes on legislative reports.

Acronym.description: Abbreviation for Legislative Entity. Only unique when paired with biennium and agency.

Action.description: The action the legislation is taking on the Revised Code Washington (RcwCiteAffected Class).

ActionDate.description: Date that action was taken on the legislation.

AgendaId.description: Unique integer for a standing committee meeting.

AmendedByOppositeBody.description: True if the chamber that did not introduce the bill passed amendments to the bill.

AmendmentExists.description: True if the legislation has amendments.

Appropriations.description: True if the bill has appropriations.

Biennium.description: Two year time period beginning on odd years. Legislation introduced during this time period can be considered in any sessions scheduled within the time period. Information is only available from 1991-current.

BillId.description: Prefix and bill number of a piece of legislation. When paired with the biennium, it is a unique reference to legislation. This field is commonly used for display purposes on legislative reports.

BillNumber.description: 3 or 4 digit number assigned to a piece of legislation.

Building.description: Reference to building on the legislative campus.

Cancelled.description: True if the committee meeting has been cancelled.

ChapterNumber.description: Session Law Chapter Number assigned to passed legislation.

ContactInformation.description: Contact information for the staff coordinating the committee meeting.

Description.description: Describes the content of the amendment or document. For amendments, if the amendment is a page and line amendment, it will list the first page and line reference. If it is a striking amendment, 'striker' will be in the description field.

DocumentExists.description: True if the legislative document related to the object's meta data is available electronically on the legislature's web site.

Drafter.description: Abbreviated designation of the amendment drafter and draft version. If the drafter begins with H-, S-, or Z-, the document has been drafted by staff in the Code Reviser's Office. Otherwise the first characters of the drafter are an abbreviation of the staff member's last name along with the version of this draft.

EffectiveDate.description: Date the legislation will take effect.

EngrossedVersion.description: The engrossed version of the bill number. Each time the bill is amended on the floor by the body it originated in, its engrossed version is incremented by one.

FloorAction.description: Action taken by the legislative body during a floor session.

FloorActionDate.description: Date of action taken by the legislative body during a floor session.

FloorNumber.description: Number assigned to a floor amendment when it is submitted to the floor for consideration. This number is unique for the legislative session.

HearingDate.description: The date the committee action occurred.

HearingType.description: The type of activity that the standing committee will do in regards to a committee meeting item (agenda item). During a committee meeting, the committee may move from one type of hearing to another as they move through the agenda items.

HistoryLine.description: One line describing the action taken on the legislation.

HtmCreateDate.description: Date and time the HTM version was created.

HtmLastModifiedDate.description: Date and time the HTML version of the document was modified.

HtmUrl.description: URL path to HTML version of the legislative document.

IntroducedDate.description: Date that the bill was read first time on the floor of the originating body.

ItemDescription.description: Less than a sentence summary describing an item on the agenda for a committee meeting.

examples: An act relating to salmon recovery

LegislativeSession.description: Session description. In the case of the amendment, it is the only session the amendment can be considered on the floor.

LegislatureNumber.description: Number of the Washington State legislative session.

LocalFiscalNote.description: True if legislation has one or more local fiscal notes.

LongDescription.description: Summary of legislation written by staff in the Code Reviser's Office. Can also be referred to as the Brief Description.

LongFriendlyName.description: Long description of the document name.
examples: Historical House Bill Report on House Bill 1000

LongLegislationType.description: Descriptive designation of the type of legislation.

LongName.description: In reference to legislative entities such as members and committees, this would be the entity's formal title.

LongRecommendation.description: A more descriptive version of Recommendation.

MultipleEffectiveDates.description: True if there are multiple dates that the parts of the legislation will take effect.

Name.description: Title of amendment, document, or entity name. Paired with the LegislativeSession, this is a unique reference to the amendment. It is also the name of the document on the legislature's web site.

OriginalAgency.description: Legislative body that the legislation was originally introduced.

PartialVeto.description: True if the governor has partially vetoed the bill.

PdfCreateDate.description: Date and time the PDF version was created. Cannot be null.

PdfLastModifiedDate.description: Date and time the PDF version was modified. Cannot be null.

PdfUrl.description: URL path to PDF version of the legislative document.

Position.description: A member's position on a committee.

PositionSort.description: Used for determining the proper order of members listed on a committee.

PrimeSponsorID.description: Unique identifier for the primary sponsor of the legislation.

RcwCite.description: Reference to a title, chapter, or section of the Revised Code of Washington.

ReferredDate.description: Date the bill was referred to the committee.

Request.description: Request number and version created by the staff in the Code Reviser's Office. This request is assigned a bill number when it is dropped in the hopper.

RequestedByBudgetCommittee.description: True if the legislation is introduced by request of a budget committee.

RequestedByDepartment.description: True if the legislation is introduced by request of a department.

RequestedByGovernor.description: True if the legislation is introduced by request of the Governor.

RequestedByOther.description: True if the legislation is introduced by request of others.

Room.description: Reference to a room in a building on the legislative campus.

Session.description: Number of the special session. This will be 0 for the regular session, 1 for the 1st special session, etc.

ShortDescription.description: Brief description of the legislation. This is commonly used on legislative reports to briefly describe the topic of the legislation.

ShortFriendlyName.description: Short description of the document name.

ShortLegislationType.description: Abbreviated designation of the type of legislation.

Sponsor.description: Common display string of sponsor name. If the bill is a committee, the string will contain the committee acronym followed by the primary sponsor of the original bill in parens.

StateFiscalNote.description: True if legislation has one or more state fiscal notes.

Status.description: Abbreviated description of the status of a piece of legislation in the legislative process.

SubstituteVersion.description: Substitute version of the legislation. Standing committees in the originating body can recommend substitutes to a piece of legislation. When the bill is considered on the floor, the legislative body will decide what version (original or a specific substitute version) they will vote on. There is no limit on the substitute version although it is rare to go above 4.

Type.description: Describes what body originally considered the amendment (Amendment Class), or sub-classification of the document (LegislativeDocument Class), or type of bill sponsor (Sponsor Class).

Veto.description: True if the governor has vetoed the legislation.

Year.description: In the SessionLaw class, this refers to the year the legislation was enacted.
